title: Audio_Builder high-power car subwoofer database
attribution: Audio_Builder high-power car subwoofer database (CC BY 4.0); every value credited to its manufacturer source in each entry
method: Subwoofers rated 2000 W RMS or more whose coils give a final load of 2, 1 or 0.5 ohm (a few with other coil impedances kept with their real loads). Values read from the maker's own spec sheets, manuals and product pages first (tier 1), then the maker's authorised distributor (tier 2) or a named independent measurement (tier 3); never forums or other databases. Research: references/research_e_hp_subs_us.md and references/research_e_hp_subs_world.md (2026-11-21/22).
corrections: Corrections go in data/hp_subs_raw/<us|world>/<brand>.json (with the source URL, document, page and date read); then run node scripts/import_hp_subs.mjs.

sources.where: maker specification sheet PDF (image), via product page https://americanbassusa.com/products/godfather-12-subwoofer, p. 1, read 2026-11-21, tier 1 (manufacturer)

drivers.notes: Sheet gives a row per wiring: params = coils in series (2 ohm); the parallel row (0.5 ohm) is in params_parallel. SD printed as 53.1 'msqM' (10^-3 m2), entered as cm2 x10. Cutout = sheet 'Diameter C' 288 mm (matches the product page cutout); displacement = sheet 'Vd'. Mounting depth not stated as such: sheet Depth G 215 mm and Depth H 246 mm (drawing letters); the product page lists mounting depth 9.29 in for the 12, which equals the motor diameter D 236 mm (possible page error). Xmech 55 mm, air gap height 25 mm. Break-in note on the sheet. | dia calculated: nominal size 12 in x 25.4 mm (not a measured outer diameter; used for the 3D view only) | Znom calculated: 1 ohm per coil, 2 coil(s), T/S basis series
